gloss: to complain; to grumble; to gripe

definitions.gloss: to complain; to grumble; to gripe
definitions.explanation: To express dissatisfaction or complaints, especially about things one cannot change, often to someone who will listen sympathetically.

examples.japanese: {愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}って⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}う。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}って⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{気|き}が{楽|らく}→気が楽：19541_kigaraku⟧になった。
examples.english: I felt a little better after venting to a friend.

examples.english: Stop just complaining and take action yourself.

notes:
⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧ originally comes from Buddhist terminology meaning spiritual ignorance or foolish attachment. In modern usage, it refers to complaints or grumbling, particularly about things that cannot be easily changed. Saying {愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}う implies a certain futility — the speaker knows complaining won't solve the problem but does it anyway.

The verb can also be ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}る→愚痴る：09293_guchiru⟧ (a casual verb form meaning "to gripe"), which is common in informal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愚痴|ぐち}を{言|い}う: to complain
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こぼす→こぼす：02104_kobosu⟧: to let complaints slip out
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen to someone's complaints
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to do nothing but complain
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}→愚痴：06623_guchi⟧⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧: prone to complaining

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文句|もんく}を{言|い}う→文句を言う：21303_monkuwoiu⟧: to complain; to object — more confrontational, directed at a specific target
- ⟦{不平|ふへい}を{言|い}う→不平を言う：25458_fuheiwoiu⟧: to express dissatisfaction — more formal
- ⟦{愚痴|ぐち}る→愚痴る：09293_guchiru⟧: to gripe — casual verb form of the same concept
